snippet.title: Ping!
snippet.description:
Listen everywhere: https://ffm.to/exyl-ping
Let's connect: https://ffm.bio/exyl

I am writing this description as of 2026 at the age of 24 while I reminisce on the crazy journey that I went through with yall. I owe the world to Exyl listeners and I just wanted to share my POV this whole time lol.

I will never forget the day this song went viral. On december 22 of 2019 i woke up at midnight because my phone was constantly throwing notifications... i checked my phone and saw that it was getting spammed by youtube comments and discord dm’s... i checked the song on youtube, and it had 100k views overnight. WOW.

That morning i was jumping all over the house from joy... but my parents told me to go back to study lol. So I did. But I was still constantly on my phone, frantically responding to the flood of messages and comments every day. I panicked because everyone wanted the song to be on Spotify and other platforms... So i found a way to upload it, but the distributer delayed it by THREE MONTHS because of christmas break... I was devastated. The algorithm slowed and the song was dead at around 600k views...

So I didn't capitalize on it. To be fair, I was only like 16 or 17 lol. I had no clue what I was doing. I was learning how a music career even works, on the fly, basically.

Randomly, I added funny subtitles to joke about the situation. I got a little carried away LOL... I made goofy comments all across the entire video. THEN, A MIRACLE HAPPENED. Over the next few weeks, purely because of the subtitles, the viewcount EXPLODED again... the song reached 10, 20, 30 million views... except now it WAS on all the music platforms including Spotify. I genuinely had a music career now... Me, a random bedroom producer from the middle east with no connections. Eventually moved for uni in Canada, and this song singlehandedly paid the bills for a while.

From then onwards, I just enjoy improving at my craft. I want to keep working on cooler and cooler projects. If you're still a fan after all these years, let's connect: https://ffm.bio/exyl

...

Epilepsy warning.
